inspiration: Frame-strip effects with timing in the file name (Textures/Explosion/frame_01_delay-0.1s.png): timing is visible to artists.
Effect atlas imported by a menu command (README.md:30): one packed sheet for many small effects.
Casting circle with rising motes (Textures/CastCircle.mat, Casting.mat, Firefly.mat): a channel read without a long animation.
Modular window frame kit with transparent and no-bottom variants and corner and bottom handles (Textures/UI).
Rising damage numbers kept in a FlyingText data folder (RebuildClient/Assets/Data/FlyingText).
Card-to-art list in plain text (Data/cardillustrations.txt): art swaps without code change.
Custom content kept in its own ID band starting at 6000 (README.md:35), away from imported content.
Minimaps generated after the lighting bake (README.md:24): an automated build step.

briefs.label: Ember rune ring (own label)
briefs.why: a casting circle with motes rising reads as channelling without a long animation
briefs.keep: ring that brightens over the cast; motes lifting from it

briefs.label: Frame-strip burst with timing in name (own label)
briefs.why: a short burst that stays readable at small size, timing visible to artists
briefs.keep: per-frame delay in file name; short strip
briefs.change: our own shard-fan burst instead of radial; two-tone palette

briefs.label: Modular window frame kit (own label)
briefs.why: corner, bottom and transparent variants let one frame style cover many windows
briefs.keep: transparent and no-bottom variants; corner and bottom handles
briefs.change: our own bevel and rivet ornament; different corner radius; our own palette

briefs.label: Rising damage number (own label)
